identity_boundary: Zhonghua and Venechor S. are indictment-reported aliases or monikers for an unnamed foreign national described as JOHN DOE 4. The person is alleged to have managed overseas IT workers and communicated with Christina Chapman; the indictment caption leaves the aliases outside its defendant list. Keep each alias separate from a verified civil identity and the three charged John Doe aliases; source imagery remains contextual rather than identity proof.
